name: W1 isinstance 元组
code:
print(isinstance(1, (int, str)))
print(isinstance('a', (int, str)))
print(isinstance([1], (int, str)))
print(isinstance(1.5, (float,)))
print(isinstance(True, (int,)))
print(isinstance(None, (int, str)))

name: W2 isinstance 元组+用户类
code:
class A:
    pass
class B(A):
    pass
print(isinstance(B(), (A, int)))
print(isinstance(A(), (B, str)))
print(isinstance(3, (A, B)))

name: W3 issubclass 基本
code:
print(issubclass(bool, int))
print(issubclass(int, object))
print(issubclass(str, int))
print(issubclass(int, int))

name: W4 issubclass 用户类
W5 issubclass 元组与异常
code:
print(issubclass(ValueError, Exception))
print(issubclass(ValueError, ZeroDivisionError))
class MyErr(Exception):
    pass
print(issubclass(MyErr, Exception))
print(issubclass(MyErr, (ValueError, Exception)))

name: W6 老 isinstance 仍对
code:
print(isinstance(1, int))
print(isinstance('a', str))
print(isinstance(1, str))
class A:
    pass
print(isinstance(A(), A))
